    if not path.startswith('/'):
        path = cwd + '/' + path
    
    components = path.split('/')
    current = []
    link_count = 0
    i = 0
    
    while i < len(components):
        component = components[i]
        
        if component == '' or component == '.':
            i += 1
            continue
        
        if component == '..':
            if len(current) > 1:
                current.pop()
            i += 1
            continue
        
        current.append(component)
        current_path = '/' + '/'.join(current[1:]) if len(current) > 1 else '/'
        
        if current_path in links:
            link_count += 1
            if link_count > 8:
                return None
            
            target = links[current_path]
            
            if target.startswith('/'):
                current = []
                target_components = target.split('/')
            else:
                parent = current[:-1]
                current = parent
                target_components = target.split('/')
            
            remaining_components = components[i+1:]
            components = target_components + remaining_components
            i = 0
        else:
            i += 1
    
    result = '/' + '/'.join(current[1:]) if len(current) > 1 else '/'
    return result
